BDB2583 [H2325]

BDB2582 | BIBLICAL HEBREW | BDB2584

[חוּב] verb be guilty (Late Hebrew id., be under obligation, guilty; Aramaic , חוּב, be defeated, guilty; Arabic be disappointed, fail; — Arabic , sin, is loan-word according to Bev Dan 1:10); —

Qal not in MT; but read perhaps חַבְתִּי (for סַבֹּתִי) 1Sam 22:22 I am guilty, so ᵑ6 Th We Dr. Pi`el Perfect inculpate וְחִיַּבְתֶּם אתרֿאֹשִׁי לַמֶּ֑לֶךְ consecutive Dan 1:10 and inculpate my head with the king.
